_note: THE X402 METER RECEIPT — session 42 on jungle4 (bnrapolltest, the estate's rehearsal seat; Vaulta is the production rail). This is the receipt's own bytes: the session row, the rate row, the nonce rows, and the event log. Every event is a LANDED transaction — the log was rebuilt from the chain's own action history (get_actions walk, 2026-09-04), every timestamp a block time; the three REFUSED probes carry no tx and no timestamp because a refusal lands nothing. Refusals are receipts too: they are named here in place. The mid-session charges (1 and 3 units) and the second settle are chain truth the dispatch receipt did not itemize — the arithmetic lands exactly with them: 0.6000 A × 8 units = 4.8000 A burned, credit 7.0000 A = 0 + 3 + 2 + 2 across four single-use nonces, one burned at zero.

The audit is NOT trusted from this file: surfaces/x402-meter.js recomputes the pure 9-check audit in the reader's page, over the live chain rows when the rail answers (fetchLive) and over these bytes when it does not — labelled either way. The four verifier states are demonstrated, not asserted: the pass-1 view (anchor stripped) audits PENDING_ANCHOR, a forged charge audits FAILED, a malformed anchor audits INCONCLUSIVE. e2e/x402-engine-parity.mjs holds this port to contracts/vending/tool/x402audit.mjs — one law, two engines, proven equal.
CARE: this is topology and vocabulary, NEVER a security claim.
